title: apricity-data: read a collection's items in order from a library (Crate until the Collection rename)
description:
## Intent

Read a collection, in order, from a library.

## Scope

- `crates/apricity-data/src/library.rs`: a facade `collections()` with `by_name(name) -> Option<Collection>` and `items(collection) -> Vec<(position, sample Value, clip Value)>` ordered by the fractional-index `position`, over the `Crate`/`CrateItem` models (`crateItemsByCrate`); names listed for "did you mean".
- Follows the rename to `Collection`/`CollectionItem` when it lands (a clean break, no alias).
- Unit tests in `crates/apricity-data/tests/` with a temp library: order after a move, an item removed, an empty collection, an item whose clip was deleted (reported, not skipped silently).

## Verification

```sh
CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=2 safe-run.sh -- cargo test -p apricity-data
```

## Release

`feat(<this task id>): read a collection's items in order`. Not breaking (no contract change).

## Dependencies

Blocked by the specs task. Coordinate with the storage session (epic apricitus-9433e6) since it owns `apricity-data`.
